proposal.title: Add two-step sign-in to the mobile app
proposal.description:
## Summary

Implement two-step sign-in (authenticator app and recovery codes) for the mobile app to improve user security.

## Background

- The current sign-in process only uses a password.
- Adding two-step verification will enhance account security for mobile app users.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] User can enable/disable two-step verification in account settings.
- [ ] App prompts for authenticator code during sign-in after password validation.
- [ ] App provides recovery codes upon enabling two-step sign-in.

## Open questions

- Should this feature be mandatory for all users or optional?
- Where will recovery codes be stored?
- Are there specific authenticator apps we should recommend or support?

## Estimate

**1 week** · AI estimate
Implementing authenticator app integration, sign-in flow logic update, and recovery code generation/storage.

More than 2 days of work: worth splitting into subtasks.

## Original request

> Write a ticket to add two-step sign-in to the mobile app: an authenticator app, a code at sign-in, and recovery codes.
